avis.titre: Love BUT what happened to the packaging
avis.texte: Love the stars themselves but the new(?) packaging drives me insane. It used it be a square of four stars with a clear plastic layer either side protecting them and it was easy to peel back and get one off. Lately the clear layer on one side is split and it makes it really hard to get one star out without the back coming off completely or upsetting the other stars. I just don't understand the concept or thought process on how it's meant to work but it's a pain in the backside and I never leave reviews but just had to because it makes me irate every time. Please go back to the simple packaging or post a tutorial because I don't know what I'm doing wrong. Considering getting an alternative brand if not. Ps: I'm a relatively normal person and don't normally get irate by trivial things.
